inference_before_unblinding: No global method winner is established. All nine Series30 clips retain clothing and a lowered-glove ending, but two action bursts can contain multiple punches; sparse samples cannot certify exact action compliance. Face size/shadow/pose limit fine identity comparison among the close cluster. Six Sully candidates resemble the creator's coarse character features but omit the vest; C10 preserves the palette and vest with a more distinct face/horn depiction and toothy ending, while C11/C14 differ substantially from the reference. A wardrobe-only bonus or a head-similarity-only objective can therefore prefer different failures. The second crossed calibration seed must test replication; continuous motion, audio and exact contacts remain unjudged.
